烤至鸡肉熟透且南瓜软熟；若熟成时间不同，先取出熟透的一样。
en-US: Preheat the oven to 210°C. Seed and cube pumpkin and coat with half the oil.
Toss chicken with minced garlic, remaining oil, salt and pepper. Arrange separately on one tray and clean items that touched raw chicken.
Roast until the chicken is cooked through and pumpkin is tender, removing either first if it finishes ahead.

names.en-US: Tofu and greens skillet patties with wood ear mushrooms

zh-CN: 木耳和小白菜切细，豆腐压碎；用部分油先炒木耳和菜，盛出稍凉。
豆腐、菜、蛋、面粉、盐拌匀，压成两张薄饼。
用余油煎到两面金黄、中心凝固熟透。
en-US: Finely chop prepared wood ear and bok choy and mash tofu. Cook the vegetables and mushrooms in part of the oil and set aside to cool slightly.
Mix tofu, vegetables, egg, flour and salt and form two thin patties.
Cook both sides in the remaining oil until golden and set through.
